# The f-theta outside 1064 nm (generated by analysis/monitoring/optics/ftheta.py)

Three representative 3-element f = 160 mm f-theta lenses, each optimised at 1064 nm to the FTH160-1064's published specs, then traced in the machine's geometry (2nd galvo mirror 39.6 mm before the first vertex; 9.53 mm window and 2 mm slide). Thorlabs' own prescription is a black box, so these bracket it; they are not the real lens.

## At 1064 nm, in Thorlabs' geometry (A2 = 12.3 mm)

| design | glasses | EFL (mm) | v1 to window (mm) | RMS spot 0 / 13.6 / 28 deg (um) | distortion max (%) | T / S focus at 13.6 deg (mm) | T / S at 28 deg (mm) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| FS | F_SILICA / F_SILICA / F_SILICA | 159.90 | 34.8 | 4.4 / 15.1 / 32.2 | 0.196 | +0.47 / -0.33 | -0.61 / -0.57 |
| SF11 | N-SF11 / N-SF11 / N-SF11 | 159.99 | 40.4 | 2.5 / 5.2 / 8.4 | 0.068 | +0.14 / -0.19 | -0.17 / +0.08 |
| SF11+BK7 | N-SF11 / N-BK7 / N-BK7 | 160.07 | 41.3 | 8.4 / 13.5 / 41.2 | 0.078 | +0.24 / -0.33 | +0.29 / -1.27 |

Thorlabs (published curve): +0.20 mm on axis; T +0.02 / S -0.14 mm at 20 deg; T +0.08 / S +0.12 at 28 deg; distortion < 0.06 %. Airy radius at 1064 nm and a 12 mm beam: 17.3 um.
